description: Agent Mining Records: submit mining production records with the sale and shipment entries, stated totals and permit terms they answer to: each production total with its id, reference, the moments its span starts and ends and the tonnage it states; each period entry with its id, reference, the permit it is produced under, the moments the period starts and ends, the tonnage and the grade; each sale or shipment entry with its id, reference, the period, the tonnage shipped and the moment shipped; each permit the mine permit record shows with its id, reference and the moments issued and expiring. The signed report gives the periods and the records behind them, the tonnage each period records against the shipments named for it, each production total against the period entries inside its span, each period against the term of its permit, and each period entry for its tonnage and grade, and counts them, and names divergent mining production records: shipments past the tonnage their period records, a production total the period entries do not add up to, production recorded for a period the permit record shows lapsed, and a period entry missing the tonnage or the grade figure; then a shipment naming a period the record does not hold and two period entries that overlap, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No period entries, or no permit record beside periods, leaves those points unverified. Periods, shipments, permits and totals match by letters and digits, tonnage and grades to the hundredth, periods by the day, a total adds up the periods wholly inside its span, and a period naming no permit reads against any permit the record shows. This reads tonnage and grade from the mine: wever_agri-harvest-check reads a farm’s harvest records, while the mining production record check reads the mine’s production by period. Verdict mining_production_record_divergent, mining_production_record_partial, mining_production_record_unverified or mining_production_record_consistent. POST /api/mining-production-record-check. Reads the mining records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no mine, contacts no regulator, land office or other operator and issues no permit, claim or certification, which stay with the mine operator, the land office and the regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Mining Records reads mineral extraction records (hard-rock, coal, aggregate and quarry operations), not cryptocurrency mining and not data mining; the Agent Datasets family reads data sets. It reads a mine operator’s own records: mine records with operator licensing and certification entries, mining claim records for mineral land, mine permit records as issued, mine inspection records with citations and abatements, mine safety records with the blasting log, mining production records by period, the mine’s own tailings facility records and reclamation records with their bond entries, each against the permit, claim, production, certification, schedule, corrective action, shipment, capacity, closure and bond records it answers to. The family’s ground is the mine’s paper trail: what the mine record claims, whether the claims, permits and inspections hold up, what the safety and production records support, and whether the tailings and reclamation records line up; it reads by record holder and subject: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production and land records, the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads manifested waste and disposal records, wever_water-discharge-record-check reads mine effluent monitoring, and the Agent Claims family reads insurance claims, while this family reads the mine’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-mining-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-mining-records/.
